name: inbox-crm
title: Inbox
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Rail, header, conversation list, thread, and party panel. Channel, stage, and the closed window arrive as props. Suggestions never send by themselves.

meta.descriptionEs: Riel, encabezado, lista, hilo y ficha. El canal, la etapa y la ventana cerrada llegan por props. Las sugerencias no se envían solas.

examples.title: Bandeja de mensajes
examples.description: Riel, encabezado, lista, hilo y ficha. El canal, la etapa y la ventana cerrada llegan por props. Las sugerencias no se envían solas.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, RTL y cantidad.

meta.usage: <InboxCrm layout="auto" conversations={conversations} messages={messages} suggestions={suggestions} onSend={send} onSuggestion={approve} party={party} onReveal={audit} />

api.name: layout
api.description: auto: rail hides under 1024, context becomes a drawer under 1280, and under 640 one column shows at a time.

api.name: conversations / messages / party
api.description: The host owns the data. There is no fetch and no Supabase client.

api.name: suggestions / onSuggestion
api.description: Approving fills the draft. onSend is not called.

api.name: locked
api.description: Closed window. Send stays disabled until the host clears it.

api.name: onReveal
api.description: Audit hook for a sensitive field. The value is not included.

api.name: status
api.description: Skeleton, empty copy, alert with retry, or an offline banner that disables send.

docs: Fuente: concepto visual de Divan Raj (@desdivj), https://x.com/desdivj/status/2119738295039250507. Licencia: sin licencia, clean-room. No se copiaron assets, logos, ilustraciones ni textos.
